discuss our\u0026nbsp;patient's identified health data shared after taking his\/her\/guardian's signed informed consent. Here we discuss our individual patient's problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patient's clinical problems with collective current best evidence based inputs. This E log book also reflects my patient-centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cu\u003EChief Complaint\u003C\/u\u003E:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA 18 year old female\u0026nbsp; came to the casuality on 3\/1\/23\u0026nbsp; with chief complaints of shortness of breath since 2days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E–fever since 1 week\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAnd pain and swelling in the perianal region since 10 days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cu\u003EHistory of present illness:\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe patient was apparently asymptomatic 6 years ago then\u0026nbsp; because of\u0026nbsp; weakness,polyuria,polydipsia,polyphagia and weight loss She went to a nearby hospital\u0026nbsp; while there, her GRBS was high and she was diagnosed with diabetes; she then started using insulin injections(mixtard)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;1 Year back History of similar complaints of swelling in inner thighs\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAt that time she consulted local doctor and recieved antibiotics ( amoxiclav 625mg\/po\/bd for 5 days and also herbal medicine for swelling.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E1week back\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient had swelling in perianal region that started as 1x 1cms and increased to the current size of 4x 4 cms along with discharge of pus and mixed with blood.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAlong with it she had high grade fever associated with chills and rigors,therfore she consulted a local doctor and received antibiotics\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EShe had used antibiotics for 5 days, later she developed nausea as her diet was improper.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETherefore she decreased her insulin dosage since 3 days and developed shortness of breath on rest since 2 days.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cu\u003EPast history\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENot a k\/c\/o hypertension, Tb, asthma, epilepsy, thyroid disorders.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cu\u003EMenstrual history:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAge of menarche: 13 years\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMenses :regular\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cu\u003EPersonal history:\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDaily routine:- she used to wake up around 7 am in the morning,take insulin injection and then have\u0026nbsp; her breakfast and go to college .Then at night before dinner she used to take an injection again (mixard)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDiet: mixed\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAppetite: decreased\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBowel and bladder: regular\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESleep: adequate\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAddictions: no\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cu\u003EGeneral Examination :\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\"\u003EPatient was conscious,
